title: Document direct GitHub Release installation and updates
description: Document GitHub Releases as the sole distribution channel, list supported platforms and asset names, and show how to place the downloaded executable in a project-local, user-local, or global PATH location on Unix and Windows. Document wtp version, wtp update, permissions, checksums, upgrades, stability, storage compatibility, and the unimplemented Trello provider.
